info.title: NexusCare Hospital Management API
info.description: Hospital management, ML pipeline, real-time SSE events

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: pending, approved, rejected

get.summary: Read a hospital's documents for review
get.description: The full rows, not the single derived `documents_status` string that `GET /admin/hospitals/{id}` returns — a reviewer needs the file URLs, expiry dates and per-document state.

patch.description: Writes `submission_status`, `reviewed_by`, `reviewed_at` and `review_notes`. A rejection must carry notes — the hospital has to know which file to replace and why. A reviewer cannot set `draft`, which is the hospital's own state.

422.description: Rejection without notes, or a return to draft

post.description: Password login for admin accounts (super/operations/verification/finance).
Revoke the refresh token and logout the user

get.description: Returns the base user record plus role-specific detail (clinician or hospital).

post.description: Send a 6-digit OTP code to the user's email address for authentication
Verify the OTP code and complete email-based authentication
Get a new access token using a valid refresh token

post.summary: Resolve a bank account number to its holder name (SafeHaven name enquiry)

post.description: Send a 6-digit OTP code to the clinician's email to start registration

post.summary: Verify OTP and create clinician account
post.description: Verify the OTP code and create a new clinician account with JWT token
Add a bank account for the clinician and validate it with Paystack

put.description: Complete the clinician profile with personal and professional information

put.summary: Replace a clinician's qualifications (feeds shift matching)

get.description: Newest first, with the overall average and total across all ratings — not just this page. `rater_name` is null for anonymous ratings, which is the default (BR-F1-48). A health worker may only read their own feed; hospitals and platform staff may read any clinician's.

post.description: Hospital admin approves a pending GPS-fallback clock-in request, unlocking the manual clock-in method for this (shift, clinician).
Hospital admin denies a pending GPS-fallback clock-in request.

get.summary: Fetch a consultation note and its transcript segments

patch.summary: Save the clinician's structured note fields

post.summary: Upload and transcribe one audio chunk of a consultation recording
post.description:
Multipart form with an `audio` file field and a `sequence` text field
(0-indexed chunk order — the browser sends these in order via
MediaRecorder's timeslice, but the server doesn't assume that).

post.summary: Mark a consultation note as completed

post.description: Register or refresh the caller's FCM device token so they can receive push notifications. Idempotent per (user, token).

delete.description: Revoke the caller's device token, e.g. on logout. No-op if the token is unknown.

post.description: Calculate distance and travel time between two locations using either coordinates or addresses
Queues an email whose subject/body are supplied by the caller (frontend-owned template). Delivered via the shared outbox → SMTP pipeline.

get.description: Convert address string to latitude/longitude coordinates using HERE Maps API
Convert latitude/longitude coordinates to human-readable address using HERE Maps API

get.summary: List all hospitals with optional filtering and pagination

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: pending, approved, rejected

get.description: Every document on file for this hospital, newest first, with its `submission_status` and — once a reviewer has decided — `reviewed_at` and `review_notes`. Scoped to the caller's own hospital; a super admin may read any. `reviewed_by` is deliberately not returned: the hospital needs the decision and the reason, not the individual reviewer's identity.

post.description: Stores the metadata for a document already uploaded to Cloudinary via `GET /api/v1/uploads/signature?kind=hospital_document`. One document per `document_type` per hospital: re-uploading replaces the previous file and returns it to `draft`, clearing any earlier review.
Moves every `draft` document to `under_review`. Documents already approved or rejected keep their decision, so fixing one file does not reopen the others.

delete.description: Only while the document is still `draft`. Once submitted it is part of the compliance record and cannot be withdrawn.

404.description: No such document for this hospital

get.description: Newest first, with the overall average and total across all ratings. Items carry the four sub-scores (staff support, equipment, communication, payment timeliness) in `dimensions`. `rater_name` is null for anonymous ratings.

get.summary: Get registration status for a hospital

GET /api/v1/hospitals/:id
Public (ungated) hospital profile enriched with ratings, shift counts,
documents status and payment-method presence. Sensitive wallet/contact/spend
data is intentionally excluded here and served only from the admin detail.

post.summary: Submit a patient for ML triage
post.description: Stores the patient intake and queues a prediction. No ML call happens inline — PatientPredictionWorker picks the row up on its next poll tick and the result is delivered via GET /api/v1/pipeline/events (SSE) or by polling GET /api/v1/patients/{id}.

403.description: No hospital associated with this account

get.description: Get address suggestions based on partial input using HERE Maps autosuggest
Find healthcare facilities (hospitals, clinics, pharmacies) near a given location using HERE Maps

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return

get.summary: Search nearby facilities with active shifts
get.description: Find nearby healthcare facilities that have active shift openings

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return

get.description: Find healthcare facilities registered with Nexuscare platform near a given location

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return

get.description: List the caller's notifications, newest first, with the unread badge count. Optionally filter to unread only.

parameters.name: unread
parameters.description: Return only unread notifications when true.

post.description: Mark one of the caller's notifications as read.

get.summary: List recent patients for the caller's hospital
get.description: Newest first. Each row includes its latest prediction if one has completed (or null while still pending).

200.description: Recent patients for the caller's hospital, each with its latest prediction

403.description: No hospital associated with this account

get.summary: Fetch a patient and their latest prediction
get.description: Poll fallback for clients not using the SSE stream at GET /api/v1/pipeline/events.

403.description: Patient belongs to a different hospital

200.description: Consultation notes for this patient, newest first

post.summary: Start a new voice-recorded consultation note for a patient

get.summary: Stream ML pipeline events for the caller's hospital
get.description: Server-Sent Events stream. Each connection is filtered to the caller's own hospital_id (from the JWT) so hospitals never see each other's patient events. Kept alive with periodic pings. Accepts the JWT via Authorization header or, as a fallback for plain EventSource clients, a ?token= query param.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: JWT, required only if the Authorization header can't be set (e.g. browser EventSource)

get.description: The fee the platform retains from a completed shift. All amounts are in NAIRA, as everywhere in this API. The fee is deducted from the clinician's payout, so a hospital still escrows the full shift total. `POST /api/v1/shifts/preview` returns the resolved figure for a specific shift.

403.description: Role may not read platform configuration

500.description: Fee configuration could not be read

patch.summary: Edit a rating (within 48 hours of submission)
patch.description: Per BR-F1-50 ratings can be updated within 48 hours of submission. Only the original rater may edit.

get.description: Searches shifts, clinicians, patients and handover notes belonging to the caller's own hospital, grouped by entity. Scoped by the `hospital_id` in the bearer token, never by a parameter. Clinicians are limited to those with a working relationship to this hospital (assigned, applied, or expressed interest) and never include an email or licence number. Patients match on name only and are returned only to hospital administrators. Platform staff should use `GET /api/v1/admin/search` instead.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
What to search for. At least 2 characters; `%` and `_` are matched
literally rather than as wildcards.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description:
Comma-separated subset of `shift,clinician,patient,handover`. All four
when omitted. An unrecognised name is a 422, not a silent no-op.

403.description: Role has no hospital to search, or may not search

422.description: Query too short, or an unknown type

get.description: List shifts with optional status filter and pagination

post.description: Create a new shift posting for hospital staff. Only approved hospitals can create shifts. Validates all required fields, checks for duplicates, generates virtual links for virtual shifts, and broadcasts notifications to eligible workers.

403.description: Hospital not approved to create shifts

post.description: Preview how a shift will appear to workers before actually creating it. Shows compensation breakdown, estimated matched workers, and virtual meeting link if applicable.

get.description: Retrieve the full shift-detail view: base shift fields plus tasks, requirements, hospital rating, and — for in-person shifts — the hospital location. When the caller is a clinician, each requirement is matched against their qualifications.

post.description: Worker accepts a pending shift offer. All 5 NDPR consent booleans must be true. On success: assignment → 'accepted', shift → 'assigned', sibling offers expire.

404.description: No pending offer for this shift

409.description: Offer expired, already responded to, clinician busy, or schedule conflict

get.description: List applications for a shift (only the shift creator can view)

post.description: Submit a shift application. The clinician is taken from the bearer token; profile details are read from the stored clinician profile. Also records shift interest, so the hospital can offer the shift.

403.description: Profile incomplete, or caller has no clinician profile

post.summary: Assign a clinician to a shift
post.description: Hospital assigns a clinician to an open shift
Worker saves a shift for later (§3.3.4).
Cancel an open or upcoming shift

post.summary: Clock in to an assigned shift
post.description: Worker clocks in. GPS method requires latitude/longitude within the hospital's clock-in radius (default 100m). Virtual method only allowed for virtual shifts. Late-clockin rules per spec §3.6.7.

409.description: Outside time window, outside geofence, or wrong status

422.description: Validation error (missing GPS, virtual method on in-person shift, etc.)

post.summary: Submit a GPS-fallback clock-in approval request (worker)
post.description: When GPS is too inaccurate to clear the geofence, the worker submits a photo of the hospital entrance plus the device coords for hospital review (§3.6.6).

409.description: Already has a pending or decided request

post.summary: Clock out of an in-progress shift
post.description: Requires a submitted handover (BR-F1-35). Computes worked_minutes and flips shift to 'completed'.

409.description: Handover missing, wrong status, or no clock-in

get.summary: Read the state of a shift's consultation
get.description: Platform admins (super/operations) get metadata only and can never obtain a token. `live: false` means LiveKit was unreachable and the participant list is the last known webhook-fed state.

403.description: Not a party to this consultation

404.description: Shift not found, or nobody has requested a token yet

post.description: Disconnects every participant and marks the session ended. Idempotent: ending an already-ended session returns the original `ended_at`. Does not clock the worker out — a handover is still required.
Fire from the Leave button and `beforeunload` in addition to `room.disconnect()`. Idempotent. Does not end the call for anyone else and does not clock the worker out.

403.description: Not a party to this consultation

post.summary: Mint a LiveKit join token for a virtual shift
post.description: Returns a short-lived join token plus the LiveKit URL. Hand `url` and `token` straight to the client SDK. `expires_at` is a join deadline, not a call deadline — the call survives it once connected. Idempotent: call again if the user sits on the pre-join screen.

403.description: Not the assigned clinician, wrong hospital, or observer mode requested by a worker

409.description: Not a virtual shift, status not joinable, outside the consultation window, or already ended

post.description: Worker declines a pending shift offer. Shift returns to 'open' so the hospital can offer it to the next ranked candidate.

404.description: No pending offer for this shift

post.description: Worker removes a shift from their nearby feed. The shift itself is unaffected; it just won't appear in this clinician's discovery results.

get.summary: Get the handover report for a shift
get.description: Returns the handover the assigned worker submitted at clock-out. Readable by the owning hospital, a super admin, or the assigned worker.

403.description: Not authorized to view this handover

post.summary: Submit (or update within 1h of clock-out) handover documentation
post.description: Records the F1-H01..H05 handover fields. Editable for 1 hour after clock-out (BR-F1-36). After 48 hours with no hospital action the handover auto-approves (Tier 3).

409.description: Wrong shift status or edit window closed

post.description: The assigned worker raises a reminder/appeal once the handover has been awaiting hospital approval for more than a day. Records the appeal and emails the hospital.

409.description: Too early, already approved, or already appealed

post.description: Marks the handover as approved by the hospital. The PayoutScheduler picks up approved shifts on its next tick and disburses the clinician's net pay via SafeHaven.

409.description: No handover submitted, or already approved

post.description: Within 24 hours of clock-out (BR-F1-37), the hospital can request a handover revision with notes.

409.description: Handover missing, no clock-out yet, or 24h revision window closed

post.description: Clinician expresses interest in an open shift. The clinician is taken from the bearer token — the request takes no body. The hospital admin is notified. Rejected with 409 if the shift is no longer open (BR: no longer available).

409.description: Interest already exists, or shift is no longer available

delete.description: Worker withdraws their interest in an open shift. Only allowed before the shift is assigned (BR-F1-17).

404.description: Shift not found, or no interest to withdraw

get.description: Return clinicians who have expressed interest in this shift, ranked by FRS §3.4.3 scoring (Distance 30, Rating 25, Experience 20, Acceptance 15, Quals 10). Names are masked to last name only until selection.

post.summary: Send a shift offer to an interested clinician
post.description: Creates a shift_assignments row with status='offered' and expires_at=now()+30 minutes. Shift remains 'open' until the clinician accepts.

409.description: Clinician did not express interest, shift not open, already offered, or worker already declined this shift

post.description: Submit a 1–5 score plus the 4 sub-dimensions (staff support, equipment, communication, payment timeliness).

409.description: Duplicate, shift not completed, or 7-day window closed

post.description: Submit a 1–5 score for the assigned clinician. The cached `clinicians.rating` average is updated in the same transaction.

409.description: Duplicate, shift not completed, or 7-day window closed

post.description: Update the start time and duration for a shift

get.summary: Get a signed Cloudinary upload payload
get.description: Returns { cloud_name, api_key, timestamp, folder, signature, upload_url }. The frontend POSTs a multipart form to `upload_url` with the file plus these fields, then saves the returned `secure_url` (hospital → PATCH /hospitals/{id}, worker → PATCH /clinicians/{id}/avatar).

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: What the upload is for: `hospital_logo` or `worker_avatar`.

get.summary: Get the caller hospital's wallet summary
get.description: Returns balance + held kobo plus the SafeHaven sub-account details (if provisioned).

403.description: No hospital associated with this account

post.description: Returns the hospital's dedicated SafeHaven sub-account to transfer into. The wallet is credited automatically when SafeHaven fires the inbound credit webhook. (Create the wallet first via /wallet/sub-account/*.)

get.description: Newest-first list of every wallet mutation: deposit credits, shift holds, releases, payouts, fees, refunds.
Payout transactions (status, amount, shift, provider reference) newest-first.

200.description: Current payout status (refreshed from SafeHaven if pending)

post.description: Pulls the hospital sub-account's transaction history from SafeHaven and credits any inbound transfer missed by a webhook (e.g. delivered to a stale callback). Idempotent.

200.description: SafeHaven transfer history for the hospital sub-account

post.summary: Complete SafeHaven sub-account provisioning with the OTP
Withdraw wallet funds to a bank account
post.description: Debits available wallet balance and transfers it from the hospital's SafeHaven sub-account to the given bank account. The destination is validated via name-enquiry; a synchronous provider rejection refunds the balance.

200.description: Current withdrawal status (refreshed from SafeHaven if pending)

post.description: Receives room_started / participant_joined / participant_left / room_finished. Authenticated by LiveKit's own signed JWT, whose `sha256` claim digests the raw body. Idempotent: re-deliveries are recognised by `WebhookEvent.id`.
Receives transfer / virtual-account / sub-account inflow notifications. Idempotent: re-deliveries are recognised by `data._id` / `data.sessionId`.

get.description: Matches FRS §3.8.7. Returns total earned, this month, pending, and a paginated list of billing_transactions joined to the relevant shift and hospital.
Lists the worker's expressed interests and formal applications across shifts, newest first.

200.description: Combined list of expressed interests and applications

get.description: Returns open shifts within `radius_km` of the worker, ranked by urgency (STAT first) then distance. Supply live `lat`/`lng` to refresh the worker's location; otherwise the last-known location is used. Virtual shifts are always included and carry no distance. Pass `require_qualification_match=true` to hide shifts whose requirements your saved qualifications do not cover — off by default, since requirements are free text and an exact-fit filter would empty most feeds.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Live worker latitude (-90..90); pair with lng

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Live worker longitude (-180..180); pair with lat

parameters.name: require_qualification_match
parameters.description: Only return shifts whose every requirement is covered by one of your saved qualifications. Off by default: requirements are free text with no shared vocabulary, so an exact-fit filter would empty most feeds. A shift with no requirements always matches.

200.description: Open shifts within the radius, ranked by urgency then distance

ActivityItem.description: A single item in the recent-activity feed. `kind` tags the source event.

latitude.description:
Optional exact coordinates from a map/GPS picker. When both are provided
they are stored as-is (overriding address geocoding); otherwise the
backend geocodes `line1/city/state/country`.

AdminActionResponse.description: Generic acknowledgement for admin mutations that don't return an entity.

notes.example: All documents verified. Hospital meets requirements.

ClinicianAvailability.description: Real-time availability status of a clinician shown in the Workforce Pool.

photo_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes. Production should switch to a presigned

ClockinMethod.description: How a clinician's clock-in was verified.

distance_meters.description: Distance from hospital in metres at clock-in (only set for GPS method).

late_minutes.description: Minutes late vs. `scheduled_start`. 0 if on time or early.

late_penalty_applied.description: True when the clinician is 15–30 minutes late (— 25% pay

ConsultClockInView.description:
Clock-in state, so the client knows whether to show "clocking you in…" and
where the manual fallback lives.

mode.description:
`"auto_on_join"` when the backend clocks in from the webhook,
`"manual"` when `LIVEKIT_VIRTUAL_CLOCKIN_ENABLED` is off.

ConsultRecordingView.description:
Recording state. Always `{ "enabled": false, "status": null }` in this
release; it ships now so the recording indicator has a stable shape.

live.description:
`true` when the participant list was reconciled against LiveKit on this
request; `false` means LiveKit was unreachable and this is the DB's last
known webhook-fed state.

ConsultShiftSummary.description: The shift a consultation belongs to, denormalised for the join screen.

ConsultationNote.description:
Voice-recorded consultation note — maps to `consultation_notes`. The
structured fields (chief_complaint..plan) are filled in by the clinician
by hand, referencing `full_transcript` — there is no LLM summarization
step in this phase.

ConsultationTranscriptSegment.description: One transcribed audio chunk within a consultation note.

password.description: Initial password the new admin uses at POST /auth/admin/login.

role.description: One of: operations_admin, verification_admin, finance_admin, super_admin.

amount_naira.description:
Amount in **naira** (e.g. 100000 = ₦100,000). Minimum ₦1,000.

Validated by a custom function rather than `range`: the stored value is
kobo, so a `range` bound here would be read as a naira bound by anyone
editing it and as a kobo bound by `validator`. Comparing kobo to kobo
leaves nothing to misread.

CreateShiftRequest.description: Payload for creating a new shift posting.

attachment_urls.description:
Cloudinary secure_urls of files attached at creation (uploaded directly
from the frontend via the signed-upload flow). Optional.

broadcast_consent_confirmed.description: Step 4: institutional verification consent (must be true to publish)

equipment.description: F1-F13: Equipment the hospital provides. Optional.

job_description.description: F1-F11: Free-text job description, capped at 2000 chars.

requirements.description: F1-F14: Required qualifications. Required, at least one entry.

tasks.description: F1-F12: Tasks the clinician will perform. Required, at least one entry.

platform_revenue_30d_naira.description: Platform fee revenue over the last 30 days.

DepositInstructions.description:
Response for `POST /api/v1/wallet/deposits` — the hospital funds its wallet
by transferring into its dedicated SafeHaven sub-account.

amount_naira.description:
The amount the hospital intends to deposit (echoed; informational —
crediting is based on whatever is actually received).

DevicePlatform.description: Platform a device push token belongs to. iOS is delivered via FCM.

DocumentType.description: The specific type of legal document being uploaded (Step 2 — Legal Verification).

clear_comment.description:
Withdraw the comment entirely. Needed because an omitted `comment` means
"leave it as it is", so there was otherwise no way to take one back.

EmailLoginRequest.description: Request to send a login OTP to an email address (AC-01).

EmailOtpVerifyRequest.description: Request to verify an email OTP and complete login (AC-01).

EndConsultRequest.description: `POST /consult/end` — the reason is optional and audit-only.

EndConsultResponse.description: `200` from `POST /consult/end`. Ending the room never clocks the worker out.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

note.description: Optional message from the worker to the hospital.

appeal_raised_at.description:
Set when the worker raises a reminder/appeal (hospital hadn't approved
after a day). Nudges the hospital before the 48h auto-approval.

HospitalDetail.description: Full hospital record for the admin drill-down view.

HospitalDocumentResponse.description: Response returned after a document upload or update.

HospitalLocation.description: Hospital coordinates for the in-person shift map view (AC-06).

HospitalPublicDetail.description:
Public hospital profile with ratings, shift counts, documents status and
payment-method presence — the general (ungated) drill-down. Excludes the
sensitive wallet balance, admin contact and spend that stay admin-only.

HospitalRatingDimensions.description: Sub-scores a worker assigns when rating a hospital. All four are

HospitalRatingSummary.description: Aggregated hospital rating shown on the shift detail screen (AC-05).

average.description: Mean of submitted 1–5 scores, `0.0` when there are no ratings yet.

count.description: Number of ratings the average is drawn from.

admin_first_name.description: First name of the hospital admin (the human contact) — used to

admin_last_name.description: Last name of the hospital admin.

email.description: Hospital + admin contact email. Login OTPs go here after approval.

HospitalSearchHit.description:
One match. `kind` is redundant with the bucket it arrives in, and is included
anyway so a client that flattens the buckets for a combined list does not
have to track provenance.

occurred_at.description: What the result is ordered by within its bucket — creation or event time.

shift_id.description:
The shift a handover belongs to, so the client can link through. NULL for
the other kinds.

HospitalSearchResults.description:
Results grouped by entity.

Grouped rather than one ranked list because the four queries have no shared
relevance score: an `ILIKE` match on a shift title is not comparable to one
on a patient name, and inventing a cross-entity ranking would be guesswork
dressed as precision. The client decides how to interleave them.

clinicians.description: Only clinicians with a working relationship to this hospital.

patients.description: Empty unless the caller's role may read patient data.

query.description: The trimmed query that was run.

HospitalSummary.description: Summary information for a hospital in list view

IssuingAuthority.description: The issuing authority for a legal document.

JoinConsultRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/shifts/{shift_id}/consult/token`. Every field is optional —
send `{}` if you have nothing to say.

device_label.description: Free text, stored in the audit trail only.

lat.description:
Worker's current GPS latitude — required for a clinician to join when the
hospital has a location on file (10 km geofence). Ignored for observers.

JoinConsultResponse.description:
`200` from the token endpoint. Hand `url` + `token` straight to the LiveKit
client SDK; everything else is UI state.

expires_at.description:
A join deadline, not a call deadline: LiveKit validates the token only
at `connect()`. Call the endpoint again if the user sits on the pre-join
screen past it.

mock.description: `true` when the backend has no LiveKit credentials — the token is fake.

JoinMode.description:
How the caller wants to join. `Observer` is hospital-admin only; a worker
asking for it gets a 403.

LeaveConsultResponse.description:
`200` from `POST /consult/leave`. Idempotent; does not end the call for
anyone else and does not clock the worker out.

limit.description: Max rows to return, newest first. Defaults to 50, capped at 200.

LoginResponse.description: Successful login response with tokens and role-based redirect (AC-06).

redirect_to.description: Role-specific dashboard path for client-side redirect (AC-06)

shift_id.description: Shift whose pending/failed payout should be (re)processed.

kind.description: Kind of record this is: "interest" or "application".

Naira.description: An amount in NAIRA (not kobo), with up to two decimal places.

NdprConsent.description: All 5 NDPR consent booleans from spec . Every one must be `true`

complete_handover.description: "I will complete handover documentation before clocking out."

hospital_systems_only.description: "I will only use hospital-provided systems for documentation."

ndpr_compliance.description: "I agree to comply with Nigeria Data Protection Regulation (NDPR)."

no_patient_capture.description: "I will not record or photograph patients without consent."

understand_violation.description: "I understand that violation may result in account suspension."

distance_km.description: Distance from the worker in km. `None` if the worker has no recorded

interest_expressed.description: Whether the caller has already expressed interest in this shift.

location_required.description:
`true` when the worker supplied no GPS and has no location on file. The
client should prompt for location access; `shifts` then carries only
entries that need no distance (virtual, and hospitals with no coords).

NewPatientRequest.description:
Payload for `POST /api/v1/ingest/patient`. `hospital_id`/`created_by`
aren't accepted from the client — they come from the caller's JWT claims.

disease_type.description:
Optional override consumed by the recommendation + routing stages
only — NOT fed to the diagnosis model, and not auto-chained from its
prediction. Matches ml-service's actual (slightly surprising)
behavior; see ml-service/main.py's `_predict_recommendation`.

unread_count.description: Count of unread notifications for the user (badge count).

ParticipantRole.description:
Who a participant is in the room. `Patient` and `Agent` are seams for
ad-hoc consults and AI agents — nothing mints tokens for them today.

PayType.description: Pay type for a shift — radio toggle in Step 2 (Shift Compensation).

PaymentDetails.description: Payment details for registration (will be tokenized, never stored raw)

PayoutRow.description: A payout row surfaced to the wallet API.

PlatformFeeResponse.description:
The platform fee, as a hospital needs to see it before creating a shift.

Amounts are **naira**, like every other amount this API returns. The ledger
keeps kobo; `utils::money::Naira` converts once, here at the boundary.

deducted_from.description:
The fee is deducted from the clinician's pay, not added to the hospital's
bill (FRS BR-F1-42). Stated on the wire so a client does not have to
guess which side bears it.

mode.description: `flat` or `percent`. Decides which field below applies.

oneOf.description:
Cap in naira on a percentage fee; `null` means uncapped. Ignored in flat
mode.

platform_fee_flat_naira.description: Flat fee in naira. Applies when `mode == "flat"`.

oneOf.description: Max fee taken per payout; NULL = no cap.

platform_fee_flat_naira.description:
Flat fee, the figure an admin types. Stored as kobo in
`platform_fee_flat_kobo`; `Naira` converts at the serialisation boundary.

platform_fee_mode.description:
`flat` (the default) or `percent`. Decides which of the two fee fields
below is actually used.

shift_close_grace_minutes.description: Minutes after `scheduled_end` before the timeout sweep closes a shift.

PredictionResponse.description: Response shape for `GET /api/v1/patients/{id}` and the SSE payload.

otp.description: OTP sent to the hospital admin's phone during sub-account initiate.

QualificationMatch.description: One requirement paired with whether the requesting clinician meets it (AC-04).

RankedInterestedClinician.description: One row in the "Interested Workers" ranked list a hospital admin sees on

acceptance_rate_pct.description: Acceptance rate as a percentage (0–100). Computed from

completed_shifts.description: Number of shifts the clinician has completed on the platform.

display_name.description: Display name. Until the clinician is selected, this is "last name only"

distance_km.description: Distance from the hospital in km. `None` if the clinician has no

quals_match.description: Whether the clinician meets every required qualification.

is_anonymous.description:
Hide the rater's identity from the ratee (BR-F1-48). Defaults to true:
ratings have always been stored anonymous, and a client that omits the
field must not accidentally start revealing who rated whom.

RatingFeed.description:
A page of ratings plus the aggregate, so a caller needs one request to
render a profile's rating section.

average.description: Mean score across *all* ratings, not just this page. NULL when none.

total.description: Total number of ratings, not the length of `items`.

RatingFeedItem.description:
One rating as it is shown to the person or hospital being rated.

Deliberately *not* `RatingResponse`: that type carries `editable_until` and
`window_closes_at`, which are the rater's business, and it has no rater name.
Here the rater is named only when they chose not to be anonymous, so the
reader cannot infer identity from what is present (BR-F1-48).

dimensions.description: Sub-scores, present on worker-rates-hospital ratings only.

rater_name.description: NULL when the rating is anonymous, which is the default.

shift_role_title.description:
Role title of the shift the rating came from — context without exposing
who the other party was.

RatingResponse.description: API response for a stored rating.

ReasonRequest.description: Reason body for suspend and worker-reject actions.

ReconcileResult.description: Result of a deposit reconcile against SafeHaven's transaction history.

deposits_credited.description: Previously-missed deposits credited during this run.

RefreshTokenRequest.description: Request to refresh an access token (AC-04).

token.description: The FCM registration token from the device.

RegistrationStatus.description: Registration status for hospital admin registration workflow (AC-01 to AC-05)

RegistrationStatusResponse.description: Response type for registration status queries

resolution.description: One of: full_payment, partial_refund, no_payment, escalate.

RevenuePoint.description: One time bucket of platform revenue.

RevenueTrend.description: Revenue over time, bucketed by day/week/month.

from.description: Inclusive window start (RFC3339). Defaults to 30 days before `to`.

to.description: Exclusive window end (RFC3339). Defaults to now.

ReviewDocumentRequest.description:
Compliance decision on a single document, written by platform staff.

`submission_status` is restricted to the two review outcomes plus
`under_review`: a reviewer cannot push a document back to `draft`, which is
the hospital's own state and would silently discard the review trail.

review_notes.description:
Required when rejecting — a rejection with no reason is unactionable for
the hospital, which has to re-upload something.

RoleCategory.description: Broad role category selected in Step 1 of the shift wizard.

html.description: Rendered HTML body (frontend-owned template). Optional if `text` is set.

text.description: Plain-text body. Optional if `html` is set.

queued_id.description: Outbox row id; the worker delivers it via SMTP shortly after.

SetAvatarRequest.description:
Set the clinician's profile image (Cloudinary secure URL, uploaded by the
frontend after obtaining a signature from `GET /api/v1/uploads/signature`).

SetQualificationsRequest.description: Body for setting a clinician's qualification tags.

qualifications.description: Full replacement set of qualification tags (trimmed, deduped server-side).

Shift.description: A shift posting created by a hospital.

actual_start.description: Actual clock-in time (set when clinician clocks in)

assigned_clinician_id.description: The clinician assigned to this shift (NULL while open)

attachment_urls.description:
Cloudinary secure_urls of files the hospital attached at creation.
`#[sqlx(default)]` so column-list SELECTs that omit it still decode.

billing_triggered_at.description: Billing is triggered only when a clinician is successfully booked

broadcast_at.description: When the shift was broadcast to the clinician marketplace (Step 5 action)

broadcast_consent_confirmed.description: Whether the hospital confirmed the institutional verification consent

completed_at.description:
When the shift reached `completed`. Written where the status transition
happens, and the anchor for the rating windows — `updated_at` moves on
any write to the row, which silently slid those deadlines.

Deliberately **not** `#[sqlx(default)]`, unlike `hospital_name` and
`attachment_urls` above. This field gates whether a rating is accepted,
and `default` makes an omitted column decode as `None` rather than
erroring — which is exactly how the first version of this change shipped
a dead anchor: every explicit column list omitted `s.completed_at`, each
read silently fell back to `updated_at`, and the fix did nothing while
compiling and passing review. A loud decode error is the right failure
mode for a column an authorization window depends on. All five
`query_as::<_, Shift>` sites select it.

department.description: Department or unit, e.g. "Hematology Unit", "Main Pharmacy"

duration_hours.description: Explicit duration in hours as entered in the wizard (e.g. 8)

hospital_name.description: Name of the hospital that created this shift

job_description.description: Free-text job description ("We need an experienced Emergency Doctor...")

matched_clinicians_at_publish.description: Number of matched clinicians the shift was visible to at publish time

notes.description: Notes or special requirements for the shift

pay_type.description: Whether pay is hourly or a fixed lump sum per shift

role_category.description: Broad role category, e.g. Doctor, Nurse (Step 1 dropdown)

role_title.description: Specific role title, e.g. "Emergency Doctor", "General Nurse"

shift_label.description: Human-readable label for the shift, e.g. "Night Shift: General Ward A"

specialty.description: Clinical specialty, e.g. Emergency Medicine, Pediatrics

urgency_bonus_pct.description: Bonus percentage applied for STAT urgency (e.g. 20 for +20%)

oneOf.description: Hospital coordinates for the map (AC-06); `None` for virtual shifts.

qualification_match.description:
Per-requirement match against the requesting clinician's qualifications

requirements.description: Required qualification tags (AC-04); empty when none are defined.

tasks.description: Clinical tasks for the shift (AC-03); empty when none are defined.

ShiftDetailResponse.description:
Enriched shift detail returned by `GET /api/v1/shifts/{shift_id}`. The base

and — for in-person shifts — the hospital location added.

platform_fee_naira.description:
Platform fee, deducted from the clinician's pay, not added to the
hospital's bill. Snapshotted onto the shift at creation, so this is the
figure that will actually settle (FRS BR-F1-42).

ShiftPriority.description: Priority level of an open shift — shown as badge on the dashboard.

ShiftType.description: Delivery mode of a shift — shown as radio toggle in the wizard.

SignedUpload.description: Everything the frontend needs to POST a signed upload to Cloudinary.

upload_url.description: The Cloudinary endpoint to POST the multipart form to.

SubmissionStatus.description: Submission state of the legal verification step.

SubmitForReviewResponse.description: How many drafts a submit-for-review call moved.

critical_patients.description: F1-H02 — Patients requiring immediate follow-up (free-form objects).

image_urls.description:
Cloudinary secure_urls of images the worker attached (uploaded directly
from the frontend via the signed-upload flow). Optional.

instructions.description: F1-H04 — Instructions for the incoming staff (required).

patients_seen.description: F1-H01 — Total patients seen during the shift.

pending_tasks.description: F1-H03 — Lab results, referrals, medications still pending.

UpdateConsultationNoteRequest.description:
Body for `PATCH /api/v1/consultation-notes/{id}` — every field optional

UpdatePlatformSettings.description: Partial update — every field optional; only provided fields are changed.

oneOf.description: Flat fee, in naira like every other amount on the wire.

UploadDocumentRequest.description: Payload for uploading a single legal document (Step 2).

UserRole.description: Role of a user within the platform.

otp.description: OTP sent to the phone registered against the BVN/NIN
